classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.strength: 400 mg/100 mg tablet (standard strength; PDL does not print strength)
preferredAgent.sig: No cirrhosis or compensated cirrhosis: 1 tablet once daily for 12 weeks. Decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B or C): 1 tablet once daily plus weight-based ribavirin for 12 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 1 tab QD x12 wk (+ribavirin if decompensated)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks; people with advanced liver scarring also take ribavirin.

records.verificationNote: Read from PDL p.46 (Hepatitis C Agents, Polymerase/Protease Inhibitors). Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir generic and Epclusa are both preferred, so no BOGL. Duration and dose are standard label values, not printed. The PA box for this section has no class-wide clinical PA line.

records.verificationNote: Epclusa tier P, PA, QL 28 tablets/28 days, SP read from PDF p.15 text layer and x-coordinate check (PA at x~430). Every DAA in the class description that is printed is PA-flagged, so all are in paRequired. Judgment: Epclusa picked as the most commonly written pan-genotypic option of the four PA products (a prescriber-practice choice, not a plan preference). Ledipasvir-sofosbuvir authorized generic and Zepatier not printed.

records.verificationNote: Epclusa 400 mg/100 mg tablet read on page 39: Tier 5 (DL), PA and QL 28 per 28 days. Every DAA listed carries PA. Harvoni (ledipasvir/sofosbuvir), Mavyret (glecaprevir/pibrentasvir), Zepatier (elbasvir/grazoprevir) and the sofosbuvir/velpatasvir authorized generic are not listed; absence is not read as exclusion. Ribavirin is listed (Tier 3, no PA, page 41) but is not a DAA. boglActive is false: no brand-over-generic preference is printed.
